name: Local Waypoints Calculator Parity with Cloud API

asi.root_cause: build_geometry includes every waypoint as per-DoF section boundary, forcing v=0 at monotonic pass-throughs per paper §III-B only true local extrema need v=0

description: Switch build_geometry to true local extrema only (paper §III-B). Duration gap 24.65%→9.13%, max_dev 0.265→0.357

asi.hypothesis: Only use true local extrema as per-DoF section boundaries, matching paper §III-B
asi.result: Major duration improvement (9.81→8.59s), but max_dev increased (0.265→0.357) vs cloud's 0.260
asi.next_step: Reduce path deviation while keeping the duration gain - need to improve the tracking/interpolation for monotonic pass-through waypoints

description: Remove pre-alignment, pass initial v/a directly to core. Duration gap 9.13%→4.20%, but max_dev 0.36→0.47

asi.hypothesis: Remove pre-alignment so core handles non-zero initial v/a directly, avoiding 0.71s braking overhead
asi.result: Duration improved 8.59→8.20s (gap 9.13%→4.20%), but deviation worsened (max 0.36→0.47, mean 0.11→0.21)
asi.issue: Non-zero initial velocity/acceleration causes tracking issues - DoFs with initial motion overshoot the reference path more easily
asi.next_step: Fix deviation by improving tracking for DoFs with non-zero initial state, especially near section boundaries

description: Smaller delta_u_ref (0.005) made everything worse - duration 8.86, kinematic fail

asi.hypothesis: Smaller delta_u_ref makes tracking tighter and reduces deviation
asi.result: Worse on all metrics: duration 8.20→8.86, max_dev 0.47→0.43 (slightly better), kinematic FAIL
asi.next_action_hint: Try larger delta_u_ref or different approach to reduce deviation

description: Larger delta_u_ref (0.02) slightly worse duration 8.25 vs 8.20

asi.hypothesis: Larger delta_u_ref gives tracking more room, might reduce oscillation
asi.result: Slightly worse on all metrics, delta_u_ref tuning not the right lever
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on section transition logic and dwell time elimination

description: Set a=m*af_fast at section transitions caused kinematic failure and worse duration

asi.hypothesis: Setting acceleration to m*af_fast at section transitions eliminates dwell time
asi.result: Kinematic FAIL and duration worse (8.62 vs 8.20). The acceleration jump violates jerk limits.
asi.next_action_hint: Need smoother section transition - can't just snap acceleration
